page.overview:
Who is B.N. Winslow?

Byles Nigel Winslow is a minor character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 to 2.

He is the current Dean of Upstate University, formerly the Principal of Reginald Vel Johnson High School.

Winslow appears as a middle-aged African-American man with a stocky physique. He has short black hair and mustache.

Winslow wears a gray coat with a white shirt underneath and a black tie. He has black pants held up with a brown belt.
